connector.name: Google Surf MCP
connector.registryDescription: Google search via Playwright with a warm Chrome profile. No API key, no proxies.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package google-surf-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the harimxchoi account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: CHROME_PATH
env.description: Absolute path to the Chrome binary. Auto-detected on Windows/macOS/Linux when omitted.

env.name: SURF_PROFILE_ROOT
env.description: Directory for the warm Chrome profile. Defaults to ~/.google-surf-mcp.

env.name: SURF_TZ
env.description: IANA timezone, e.g. America/New_York. Defaults to system timezone.

env.name: SURF_HEADLESS
env.description: Set to 'false' to run Chrome visibly (demos/debugging). Defaults to true. CAPTCHA recovery always runs visible regardless.

env.name: SURF_IDLE_CLOSE_MS
env.description: Idle ms before closing the sequential ctx and pool. 0 disables idle auto-close. Defaults to 30000.

env.name: SURF_ALLOW_PRIVATE
env.description: Set to 'true' to allow extract on private/loopback addresses (localhost, 10.x, 192.168.x, 169.254.x, etc). Default blocks them as an SSRF guard.
